# Cluster B review — services + fa_network_client (PR #1881)

## Findings

**1. [SUGGESTION] `flutter_app/lib/services/codemie_extension_signin.dart:99` — `openLoginPage()` moved out of the try/catch, changing its exception surface.**
Old (from `git show 59fb4482ce:flutter_app/lib/services/codemie_extension_signin.dart`):
```dart
while (true) {
  try {
    final result = await probe();
    ...
    if ((result.status == 401 || result.status == 403 || loggedOutHtml) && !loginAsked) {
      loginAsked = true;
      openLoginPage();          // inside try — a throw was swallowed by `on Object`
    }
  } on Object { /* keep polling */ }
```
New:
```dart
while (true) {
  final (models, openLogin) = await _probeCodeMieSignIn(probe, loginAsked: loginAsked);
  if (models != null) return models;
  if (openLogin) {
    loginAsked = true;
    openLoginPage();            // outside any try — a throw now escapes pollCodeMieSignIn
  }
  if (_pollAbandoned(cancelled, deadline)) return null;
```
Everything else in the poll (probe/parse swallowing, first-logged-out-signal gating, cancel/deadline short-circuit order, interval delay) is provably identical. Only a throwing `openLoginPage` callback changes behavior: swallowed pre-PR, propagated post-PR. Real-world risk is negligible (the callback just opens a browser tab), and the old swallowing was arguably accidental — flagging for completeness, not blocking.

No other genuine findings in this cluster.

## Per-file verification notes

- **`network/fa_network_client.dart`** (hunk @644): `_faHeaders`/`_buildFaRequest`/`_sentTokenClass` extraction is order-identical (headers built before body encode, token class computed lazily inside the same log line). The `bearer=…` diagnostic still logs only the token CLASS (jwt/session/none/off), never the value; log string, `_errorFor`, and thrown exception unchanged. No leftover duplicate code in the new file (read 630–740). CLEAN.
- **`services/ain_connect_flow.dart`**: ⚠️ the read tool could not open this file at all (`FileError(notFound)` on every attempt/offset, though `ls` lists it — possibly a dangling symlink or harness quirk, worth a maintainer glance). Verified entirely from the complete diff hunks instead: `_runAiinMobileCliFlow` preserves the exact catch-clause order (`AiinSurfaceClosedException` → `PlatformException` → `MissingPluginException`, including the pre-existing shadowing where `MissingPluginException extends PlatformException` matches the second clause first — same as old), the same two trace strings, the same `timeout: 5min/3min`, `cancelWhenOpenSettles: authSession`, and the same browser/intercepted/onCallback wiring. CLEAN per diff.
- **`services/backup_exclusion.dart`**: kIsWeb-first short-circuit preserved inside `_backupExclusionApplies()`; override seam still wins first; `MissingPluginException`/`PlatformException` handling byte-identical. Full file read — no dead leftovers. CLEAN.
- **`services/calendar_tool.dart`**: pure rendering extraction. Segment append order (calendar → location → recurrence → alarms → url → notes) and every literal (`' (' … ')'`, `' @ '`, `' [alarm … before]'`, url/notes shapes, 120-char note truncation) identical; no wall-clock/timezone/`_dateLabel`/`_timeLabel` logic touched. CLEAN.
- **`services/chatgpt_oauth_flow.dart`**: switch→if-chain over the same 3-value enum is exhaustive-equivalent (unknown future values fall to the CLI leg in both). The "Opening browser for ChatGPT sign-in…" snack and `runChatGptOAuthCliFlow` tail are unchanged context; `_acquireViaSystemSession`/`_acquireViaEmbeddedWebView` pre-existed. No token material in logs/errors; error surfaces (`_refuse`, exchange-error callback) untouched. CLEAN.
- **`services/flutter_session_manager.dart`**: `findReusableSession` extraction verified line-by-line — list/cached fallback, empty check, `createdAt.toLocal()` today test (the pre-fixed slip stays fixed), `_tooLarge` gate BEFORE the user-message scan, windowed-open → full-open fallback → "treat unreadable as non-empty" (`return true` ⟺ old `return null` from caller) all preserved in order. CLEAN.
- **`services/media_tools.dart` (media + video command construction)**: `_resolveVoice` matches both old ternaries incl. `'Kore'`/`'alloy'` fallbacks; `_postSpeech` posts to `'${endpoint.baseUrl}/audio/speech'` with the same header set and same body key order (`model`, `input`, `voice`, `response_format`), same `finally`-close of the self-owned client, same `StateError('Speech synthesis failed (HTTP …): …')`. Video path: `_normalizedVideoOptions`, `_videoJobId` (same "returned no job id." message), `_videoJobPollUri` (same `polling_url` → `{baseUrl}/videos/{id}` fallback), `_videoSaveDetail` all identical; request argv unchanged. `_deepFindAudioBase64` refactor preserves exact traversal order and all five audio-carrying keys. Remaining hunks are a blank-line and a wrap-only tuple reformat. CLEAN.
- **`services/video_tool.dart`**: `_visionPrompt` reproduces the prompt byte-for-byte (same label list, same `${extracted.length}`, same two instruction branches with `$question`); chat/completions URL, headers, and content array order unchanged; `_decodeVisionContent`/`_firstChoiceText`/`_firstChoiceMessage` preserve the old shape checks and the same final `StateError('Video reading returned an unexpected response.')`. CLEAN.
- **`services/widget_publish_service.dart`**: `_ensureWidgetRepo` preserves both branches — E7 kill-resume (`stepRepoPushed` + `repoFullName.contains('/')`) returns `(owner, name, existing.repoCommit)`; else `_publishRepoTarget` (recorded repo vs `login`/`sanitizeRepoName`) then `_pushWidgetRepo` with identical API-call order (getRepo → createRepo → private refusal → getHeadSha → provenance guard → README bootstrap `putFile` → `_collectWidgetFiles` → blobs → tree → commit `'Publish ${app.id} ${app.version}'` → updateRef → `_ledger.record(stepRepoPushed, submittedAt: _clock().toUtc(), prNumber/prHtmlUrl carried over)`), identical error strings. PR step below the fork is untouched context. CLEAN.
